verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair thing to ask of an online government filing service, so this axis applies. The evidence only describes the web portal (dashboards, online filing, FranceConnect+ login), a mobile tutorial app (Start INPI) and qualified e-signature requirements. Nothing shows an official command-line tool for Guichet unique formalities. The keyless recherche-entreprises API probe concerns a separate state data API, not a Guichet unique CLI.
